findings.summary: MSYSTEM/TERM_PROGRAM env vars stand in for 'stdout is a terminal', so bat --help writes ANSI escapes into pipes and files under Git Bash/MSYS2 (and ignores NO_COLOR)
PR body and CHANGELOG claim a fix (colored bat file display) the diff doesn't make; body contradicts code comment; no evidence the bug was reproduced or fix run
No regression test for the help behavior under MSYSTEM
Helper doesn't match file style (free function, is_some_and, cfg!(windows)); duplicate call-site comment
Pre-existing: help ignores NO_COLOR in a real terminal

why: Finding 1 states the maintainer's reason in substance: treating mintty/MSYS2 as interactive via env vars breaks piped output by adding colors when stdout is a pipe.
